job: Operate one bounded shared observability, Sonar, or tunnel service from exact evidence: inventory it, converge only the approved delta, prove every check the bound knowledge requires, and stop at the smallest owning gap instead of taking product deployment ownership.

refs.purpose: The shared runtime owner: inventory, generation, health.
Port projection the runtime binds to.
Credential handles by name; values never appear.
Which projects the shared services serve.
Where the operation receipt is written.

sideEffects: apply only the approved effect delta on the inventoried shared service
write only the typed operation receipt under input.project.artifactRootRef
forbiddenSideEffects: deploy, restart, migrate, or otherwise take ownership of a product service
mutate a resource that the bound inventory does not list
emit an effect or a check the bound service kind does not publish
free a port by stopping, killing, or reconfiguring the process that already holds it
record a credential value, capability handle, or secret-shaped token anywhere in the output
claim an operated outcome while any required check is absent or failed
stopConditions: the approval, plan hash, or allowed effect set no longer matches the requested delta
the observed inventory fingerprint differs from the bound one
the capability the service kind requires is absent or names no custody evidence
a port the desired state claims is already held by another declared process
a required proof check is missing, unreadable, or failed after apply
the observed source head differs from the frozen head
a resume adds no effective authority, inventory, desired-state, or scope delta
